summary.text: You can save up to the Basic Healthcare Sum in your MediSave Account before age 65.

details.heading: The maximum amount
details.body: The maximum amount you can hold in your MediSave Account is the prevailing Basic Healthcare Sum, if you have not turned age 65.

details.heading: The 2026 amount
details.body: From 1 January 2026, the Basic Healthcare Sum is $79,000 for CPF members aged 65 and below.

details.heading: After age 65
details.body: Your applicable Basic Healthcare Sum is adjusted yearly until you turn 65. If you are 65 in 2026, it stays fixed at $79,000 for life.

example_phrasings: Is there a maximum amount that I can save in my MediSave Account?
How much can I keep in MediSave?
What is the MediSave savings limit?

sources.page_title: Is there a maximum amount that I can save in my MediSave Account?

quotes.text: You can save up to the prevailing Basic Healthcare Sum (BHS) in your MediSave Account (MA) if you have not turned age 65.
It is the maximum amount you can hold in your MA.
From 1 January 2026, the BHS is $79,000 for all CPF members aged 65 years and below.
The BHS applicable to you will be adjusted yearly to keep pace with rising healthcare consumption until you turn age 65.
